content.text:
The result of (37 × 12 + 159) ÷ 9 is **67**. Calculator shows "603 ÷ 9 = 67".

My first attempt entered the expression without parentheses, so Calculator applied normal precedence and returned 461.67. I re-entered it as 37 × 12 + 159 = 603, then ÷ 9 = 67.
